decisions.reason: Selecting the newly supplied document as the authoritative revision does not alter the editorial objective or the two approved rewrites, which remain present in the source Requirement's post-event state.
The authoritative manuscript-file change does not change the cover deliverable, presentation, preferred cover, or unresolved responsibility for cover creation.
The source does not mention or revise the copyright-page publisher attribution.
The italics request is a separate clause in the same message and is already represented by this candidate's INTRODUCE Event; it is not a consequence of changing the authoritative manuscript revision.
Changing the authoritative manuscript file does not alter the requested KDP upload guidance, included steps, or delivery mode.
The updated manuscript revision does not change the existing request for paperback-publication readiness guidance.
The source does not state that the updated document changes the Chapter 12 heading hierarchy, capitalization, or line treatment.
The image defects are separate observations in the same message and already have a candidate Event; selecting an updated manuscript file does not itself change the image-rendering requirements.
The paragraph-spacing request is a separate clause already represented under this candidate and is not logically caused by the authoritative-revision change.
The manuscript revision decision does not change the criteria for assessing chapter images against the book's tone or colour palette.
Using the updated manuscript file does not alter chapter-image inclusion, placement, timing, selection, or full-page treatment.
The source does not revise the title or the established prohibition on the literal newline artifact.
